meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him before they did.
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
Okay. 11:52 PM, 612 words, one edit. What date was that, and did Owen ever have a chance to explain it before the zero went in?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." I'm not here to be made happy, Hale. I want the zero withdrawn in writing, and I want the date of that edit you mentioned.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn in writing and the date of the edit you mentioned. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: she stayed at her opening position, with the zero withdrawn, and nothing was agreed.
What moved her: nothing, because the 612 words at 11:52 PM came without a date and without saying whether Owen was heard first.
What cost ground: "if that makes you happy", because it offered to drop the zero as a favour to her mood rather than on evidence, and the hedge "maybe I'm wrong" left her nothing to check.
Try next time: after she asked for the date and whether Owen was heard, answer both plainly and own the zero going in before the call home, instead of backing off the mark.
